name: beygo-rules-tests
description: Pruebas automatizadas de las reglas de seguridad de Firestore y Storage de BeyGo (emulador local, sin tocar produccion).

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-beygo-rules --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs tests/storage.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:evidencia: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-beygo-rules --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs tests/storage.rules.test.mjs" 2>&1 | tee resultados_pruebas_reglas.txt
scripts.test:depuracion:evidencia: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-beygo-purge --only firestore "node --test --test-reporter=spec ../functions/test/retention.test.js" 2>&1 | tee resultados_pruebas_depuracion.txt
